scope: Scenario starts and one fall fault are explicit test-only teleports. Stair ascent/descent use real controller movement with no per-step teleports; E uses production physical binding. Midride blockers are explicit fault fixtures. Floor dimensions/layouts/people are authored source-linked game representations, not surveyed or actual public access. Native GPU captures only when display is not headless; no native-human-input, performance or packaging acceptance.
